sources.name: O*NET Database
sources.attribution: O*NET Resource Center by the U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration (USDOL/ETA). O*NET is a trademark of USDOL/ETA.
sources.refreshNotes: Use O*NET downloadable tab-delimited or SQL files for occupation titles, skills, knowledge, education/training, work context, tasks, and tools. Keep derived data compact.
sources.runtimeUse: General occupation intelligence, sparse JD enrichment, expected skills/tasks/tools, and job-zone strictness hints.

sources.name: European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations
sources.license: European Commission open data terms; API software is EUPL 1.2 with Apache 2.0 components
sources.refreshNotes: Use selected CSV/JSON-LD exports for occupation and skill aliases. Do not ship full raw exports unless needed.
sources.runtimeUse: Multilingual occupation/skill aliases and non-US occupation matching.

sources.name: NIST NICE Workforce Framework for Cybersecurity
sources.license: U.S. government public information; verify downloaded file notices
sources.attribution: National Institute of Standards and Technology NICE Framework.
sources.refreshNotes: Use NICE component JSON/XLSX for work roles, task, knowledge, and skill statements.
sources.runtimeUse: Cybersecurity work-role mapping and strict handling for clearance/security-sensitive work.

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.refreshNotes: Prefer small curated helpers or consented API lookup by ORCID/name. Do not ship large snapshots by default.
sources.runtimeUse: Academic/research CV mode: publications, venues, topics, institutions, funders, and author identifiers.

sources.name: FAA Airmen Certification Downloadable Database
sources.license: U.S. government public information; verify FAA file notices
sources.attribution: Federal Aviation Administration Airmen Certification data.
sources.refreshNotes: Use certificate category references only unless a user explicitly consents to identifier lookup. Medical data is not authoritative.
sources.runtimeUse: Aviation certificate/rating detection and strict no-claim-without-evidence handling.

sources.license: U.S. government public information; verify CMS data dissemination terms
sources.attribution: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services NPPES/NPI data.
sources.refreshNotes: Use provider taxonomy/category references by default. Do not treat taxonomy as professional license verification.
